# IMRNES

> Ingin Menjadi Root — cyber security community member list. CTF achievements, CVE
> discoveries, and the CTFtime leaderboard standing for Indonesia.

## Pages

- [Members](https://imrnes.team/): community member list with profiles and contacts.
- [Achievements](https://imrnes.team/achievement): CTF achievements and the roster behind each
  win, by IMRNES team members.
- [CVE Discovered](https://imrnes.team/cve): CVE entries discovered by IMRNES team members,
  sourced from the IMRNES zero-day list.
- [Leaderboard](https://imrnes.team/leaderboard): IMRNES standing on the CTFtime leaderboard for
  Indonesia, with the top teams around.

## Optional

- [Forum](https://forum.imrnes.team): community forum.

## Notes

- CVE data is fetched from a remote markdown source and revalidated hourly.
- Leaderboard data comes from the CTFtime API, revalidated hourly.
